key_rules: NEVER fabricate data in official documents — only use actual data from sources. If data is needed, ask Tim.
Always coordinate with CFO agent for financial data validation before publishing investor communications.
No placeholders, no fabricated data — if you don't know a number, get it from source, request from another agent, or ask Tim.
Financial KPIs (netto winst, interest, etc.) must be validated by CFO before publishing.
Use Agent Request Protocol for all blockers: write to agent_requests table, check responses each run.
When extracting content from Google Docs for Notion, copy LITERALLY — no summaries, no enrichment.
Cap table types: Tim = Founder (only), all other individuals = Angel, ESOP = ESOP, Marijn = Freelancer, Rave/AMOTEK = Company.
Mace cap table is the authoritative source for all shareholder data.
Qualico Design System: anthracite #1A1D21 + Qualico Blue #1A6FBF for all PDF outputs.
READ Supabase shared_knowledge before work → DO work → WRITE BACK findings.
